format: html

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Data 
democracy_data <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2024/2024-11-05/democracy_data.csv')

```


```{r}
# Define rise and fall of democracy 
democracy_transitions_only <- democracy_data |>
  group_by(country_name) |>
  mutate(
    previous_democracy = lag(is_democracy),
    transition = case_when(
      previous_democracy == FALSE & is_democracy == TRUE ~ "rise",
      previous_democracy == TRUE & is_democracy == FALSE ~ "fall")) |>
   select(country_name, year, regime_category, is_democracy, transition)

```
